steps.title: 360° breathing + pelvic floor + deep core
steps.details: Start with about 5 slow 360° breaths. Then do 5 × 3 s submaximal pelvic-floor lifts, with 6–8 s of complete relaxation after every lift. Finish with a short easy deep-core control set.
steps.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Keep a comfortable neutral low back; do not force it flat into the floor.
steps.feel: Lower ribs, belly and back expand on the inhale. Pelvic floor fully relaxes between contractions.
steps.avoid: No breath holding, hard bracing or continuous pelvic-floor clenching.
steps.minuteCue: Check that you are breathing into ribs + belly + back and fully relaxing between lifts.

steps.title: Light conditioning
steps.details: Fast march or easy jumping jacks. Keep it light, around RPE 6/10 — the goal is to wake up, not fatigue the legs before evening gym.
steps.minuteCue: Stay easy and smooth; do not turn this into HIIT.

steps.title: Chin tucks
steps.details: 2 × 10 slow controlled reps. Draw the head straight back rather than looking down.
steps.feel: Gentle work deep in the front of the neck; back of the neck stays long.
steps.avoid: Do not jam the chin down toward the chest.

steps.title: Wall slides
steps.details: 2 × 10 controlled reps. Slide the arms upward only as far as you can while keeping the ribs controlled.
steps.avoid: Do not compensate by strongly arching the low back or flaring the ribs.

steps.title: Prone Y–T–W
steps.details: 2 rounds of about 6 reps in each Y, T and W position. Move slowly and focus on shoulder-blade control rather than lifting the hands high.
steps.minuteCue: Continue the sequence; move into the next letter or second round.

steps.title: Dynamic Yoga Flow
steps.details: Flow continuously: Downward Dog → Plank → Cobra or Upward Dog → Downward Dog → Low Lunge (Anjaneyasana) + both arms overhead → Downward Dog → repeat with the other leg. Keep moving smoothly rather than holding long static stretches.
steps.setup: Use the whole mat. In Low Lunge, the rear knee can stay on the floor; lift both arms overhead and grow tall through the torso.
steps.feel: Whole-body mobility: shoulders, spine, front of hips, calves and posterior chain, with calm breathing throughout.
steps.avoid: Do not force Upward Dog if Cobra feels better. Avoid painful end ranges or holding your breath.
steps.minuteCue: Keep the flow moving; make sure both lead legs are getting equal time.

steps.title: World’s Greatest Stretch
steps.details: From a long lunge, bring the inside elbow toward the floor or inside of the front foot, then rotate the same-side arm upward for thoracic rotation. Return and change sides. Keep it dynamic and alternate rather than sitting in one position for a long time.
steps.feel: Hip/groin opening plus thoracic rotation and a broad stretch through the whole body.
steps.avoid: Do not force the elbow to the floor or twist through pain.
steps.minuteCue: Switch the lead side / keep alternating sides.

sunday.later: Optional swim or Zone 2 outside the 30-minute mobility timer

steps.title: Calm 360° breathing
steps.details: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Keep a comfortable neutral low back — do NOT force it into the floor. Put your hands around the lower ribs. Inhale slowly through the nose and let the lower ribs, belly and back expand 360°. Let the pelvic floor soften on the inhale. Exhale slowly and let the ribs settle without hard bracing.
steps.setup: On your back, knees bent, feet flat. Support your head if that is more comfortable.
steps.feel: Expansion around lower ribs, belly and back; calm breathing and pelvic-floor relaxation.
steps.avoid: Do not flatten the low back, suck the belly in, brace hard or hold your breath.
steps.minuteCue: Check: ribs + belly + back are all moving, not only the upper chest.

steps.title: Cossack squat / adductor mobility
steps.details: 2 × 6 / side. Stay in a comfortable range.
steps.minuteCue: Change the side you are emphasizing.

steps.title: Hamstring sweeps
steps.minuteCue: 1-minute marker: continue, change side or start the next set as planned.

steps.title: Half split
steps.details: From half-kneeling, shift hips back over the rear knee and straighten the front leg until you feel a hamstring stretch. Keep pelvis square and spine long.

steps.title: Seated forward fold
steps.minuteCue: Relax shoulders, re-lengthen spine; do not force deeper.

steps.title: Hip-flexor stretch
steps.details: Half-kneeling: one knee down, opposite foot forward. Gently tuck the pelvis (belt buckle slightly toward ribs) and squeeze the glute of the kneeling-side leg. Then shift the whole pelvis only a little forward. The stretch should be at the front of the rear hip/thigh.
steps.setup: Hands may rest on hips or front thigh for balance.
steps.feel: Front of hip / upper thigh of the leg whose knee is on the floor.
steps.avoid: Do not just lunge far forward or arch the low back.

steps.title: Ankle rocks
steps.details: Face a wall or use a split/kneeling stance with one foot flat. Keep the heel planted and move the knee forward over the toes, then back. Let the knee track roughly over the 2nd–3rd toe. Hands can touch the wall or knee for balance, but they do not drive the movement.
steps.setup: Start with toes a few centimetres from a wall; adjust distance so the heel stays down.
steps.feel: Movement/stretch around the ankle and calf while the heel stays planted.
steps.avoid: Do not lift the heel or let the knee collapse inward.
